title: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
meta: 1 May 1947 · Forced labour and compulsory service
summary: Highlights the drafting difficulty of prohibiting forced labour without unintentionally disabling compulsory public service, contributing to the decision to remit the clause.

title: Frank Anthony
summary: Defends the practical substance of the right to propagate religion and raises family consequences of an absolute bar on conversion of minors.

title: P. R. Thakur
summary: Approaches conversion from the standpoint of Depressed Classes and asks whether fraud should cover inducement and exploitation of vulnerable communities.

title: J. J. M. Nichols-Roy
summary: Opposes an absolute age-based prohibition and argues that young people also have claims of religious conscience that should not be suppressed by overbroad law.

title: Purushottam Das Tandon
summary: Argues against treating minors as fully capable of valid religious conversion and supports stronger protection against conversion before maturity.

title: Dhirendra Nath Datta
summary: Questions how minority script protections would interact with future efforts by a Unit to adopt a common script for administrative or social purposes.
